day1-video.notes: 4단계 완료. (1) --inspector-width clamp(320px, 100vw - 950px, 440px). (2) 프리뷰를 렌더와 일치(패널 슬롯 비율 + cover + 패널 transform). (3) 패널 Fit 옵션(cover/contain) + contain일 때 블러 배경(프레임 1장 디코드). (4) 사용자 결정으로 Day1 패널 기본 프레이밍을 contain으로 전환 - 업로드가 조용히 크롭하지 않게. 신설 DEFAULT_DAY1_PANEL_TRANSFORM을 패널 초기값/resetDay1Transform이 사용하고, setDay1PanelSource가 트림과 함께 프레이밍도 초기화(relink는 유지). 3장면은 cover 고정. 저장된 기존 프로젝트는 fit cover를 들고 있어 렌더 결과 불변, 마이그레이션 없음. 유닛 415/415, tsc 통과. 남은 검증: Chrome 환경에서 Day1 e2e 3종 1회.

realDeviceMeasurement.m0GateVerdict: M0 predicted 1.15x from the VP9 substitute; actual is 1.30x, so the prediction was 13% optimistic. The direction (sub-linear in panel count, four panels practical) held and the gate conclusion stands.

openObservations: 30s at 60fps leaves only 19% headroom under the 52MB cap; a busier source may exceed it, and dropping to 30fps roughly halves the size

the @remotion/media video cache keeps sources open across template switches (7 blobs / 419MB while rendering a 3-source day1 project) - no failure observed, but memory accumulates in a long session; a refresh clears it

kv-object-animation.notes: Cycle complete. Match Rate 100%, SC 7/7 measured on the real-device H.264 on/off pair (diff-domain pipeline in artifacts/kv-obj-m5/, codec-noise yardstick = same-phase cycle-repeat diff). D-05 settled: on/off total render time delta -2.2% < 5%, effect cost ~0.27ms/frame in createFrame. Next-cycle inputs recorded in report §5: one-click object designation (AI segmentation, Plan §1.4 reserved) and requester's new ask - object-level motion (zoom in/out on the designated object), which needs masks before it can move pixels.
